correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct graph distances classify all mixed cliques, giving a collineation-invariant cover X=U∪V with U contractible, V homotopy-equivalent by inclusion to the join of q+1 discrete q-line direction factors, and exact intersection equal to original incidence graph G. Integral join Künneth carries the determinant sign on factor permutation; equivariant Mayer–Vietoris identifies Hq and H2, no other reduced groups for q>=3. Graph chain characters and cyclic tensor trace give the two formulas. For finite-field planes all nonzero translations fix q lines in their direction and no flags; averaging traces gives vanishing H2 invariants and the displayed top rank. Barycentric subdivision proves rational quotient homology equals invariants even with nonfree simplicial action.
